phrases.p: I'm a welder with experience in fabrication and metalwork.
I take safety and quality seriously in every job.
phrases.u: State the standards that guide your work.

phrases.p: I'll keep the team updated as the task progresses.
Could you clarify the priority for this shift?
phrases.u: Ask a supervisor a clear question.

phrases.p: I checked the equipment before starting the task.
The grinder needs attention before we use it.
The material specification calls for this thickness.
Let's confirm the joint preparation before we begin.
I will stop work until the area is safe.
My PPE and ventilation checks are complete.
I will follow the approved welding procedure.
Let's check the parameters before the next pass.
Could we confirm this dimension on the latest drawing?
I want to make sure I am using the correct revision.
I need access to this area after the other trade finishes.
I'll let the supervisor know about the schedule change.
The inspection found an issue that needs correction.
Let's agree on the corrective action and recheck it.
The permit and isolation checks are in place.
I will follow the site procedure and report any concern.
My experience has taught me to work safely and reliably.
I am looking for a team where I can contribute and grow.
I am ready to contribute high-quality work from day one.
My goal is to keep developing while meeting professional standards.
